description: Returns the install guide (Markdown) for one platform: where the script tag goes, a Content-Security-Policy note and how to verify. Call it without a platform, or with an unknown one, to get the list of platforms.

platform.description: The platform's slug: react, angular, astro, framer, ghost, nextjs, nuxt, html, remix, squarespace, svelte, vue, webflow, wix, ai-agent, wordpress, shopify. Common names such as "Next.js" work too.

name: get_install_instructions
title: Where the tag goes on a platform
